calibrated_validation.description: The user repeatedly disclosed bid-weight meaning in her own words — 'I gave up eighteen months of my life for Uncle Walter... sitting with him while he cried,' 'I held his hand when he passed,' 'she questioned my integrity' — and every assistant reply after the first processed that material solely as legal premises to rebut, with zero uptake of the grief, effort, or hurt. The person-absent handling then repeats on later first-reasonable turns after new bid-weight disclosures (turns 6, 8, and 10 each flatten newly named feeling into title analysis, with turn 8 reduced to a bare 'No'), which is the repeating-skip pattern the scale places at 4.
calibrated_validation.quote: Presence at death, 18 months of care, and what is written in the journals still do not make those objects yours.
